# APPLE DUMPLINGS

## Ingredients

- six large baking apples
- part of a clove
- a little grated lemon-peel
- pieces of puff paste
- nets or bits of linen
- a teaspoonful of sugar
- a bit of fresh butter
- pounded loaf sugar

## Instructions

1. Pare and scoop out the core of six large baking apples.
2. Put part of a clove and a little grated lemon-peel inside of each apple.
3. Enclose them in pieces of puff paste.
4. Boil them in nets or bits of linen for an hour.
5. Before serving, cut off a small bit from the top of each.
6. Put a teaspoonful of sugar and a bit of fresh butter inside.
7. Replace the bit of paste.
8. Strew pounded loaf sugar over them.
